claim_boundary: This catalog enumerates source-grounded design candidates. Scores estimate benchmark promise; they do not report model trials.

sampling_design.description: Fifty scientific problem families are crossed with four resource scales and five operational situations, yielding exactly 1,000 auditable candidate concepts.
sampling_design.unit_of_sampling: A candidate is a benchmark-design contract, not yet a materialized Harbor task.

scale_regimes.label: tiny exact oracle
scale_regimes.description: Use a small instance with an independent dense or analytic oracle.

scale_regimes.label: balanced benchmark
scale_regimes.description: Use the intended production regime with a target expert p95 runtime below 180 seconds.

scale_regimes.label: representation stress
scale_regimes.description: Scale past naive dense simulation so the documented TensorCircuit representation is essential.

scale_regimes.label: runtime edge
scale_regimes.description: Push close to the 300-second submission ceiling; retain only if the expert implementation keeps large headroom.

situations.label: forward observable
situations.description: Compute a physically meaningful observable or state diagnostic from fixed inputs.

situations.label: inverse identification
situations.description: Infer hidden parameters from seeded observations and validate on held-out interventions.

situations.label: finite-shot noisy
situations.description: Operate under an explicit seeded noise and shot budget with a precomputed variance margin.

situations.label: adaptive closed loop
situations.description: Use intermediate results to choose later circuit operations or experiments.

situations.label: robust ensemble
situations.description: Satisfy one frozen objective across a seeded ensemble of perturbations or hidden instances.

families.title: Conditioned fermionic-Gaussian Kitaev quench
families.objective: Evolve a Kitaev-chain Gaussian state, condition on occupation outcomes, and recover parity correlators or hidden quench parameters.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit's FGS covariance engine for Bogoliubov evolution, measurement conditioning, and parity observables; forbid dense Jordan-Wigner statevectors at production scale.
families.oracle_design: Exact Jordan-Wigner simulation on tiny instances plus an independent covariance-matrix implementation on production instances.
families.novelty_note: Adds specialized fermionic simulation and conditional Gaussian measurement, absent from tasks 01-12.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Requires translating BdG/covariance conventions into an unfamiliar specialized API, then composing measurement conditioning with inverse validation.
families.falsification_check: Reject if the pinned FGS API cannot reproduce exact small-system correlators and gradients with fixed ordering conventions.
review_questions: Is the FGS API stable in the pinned image?
Can parity and occupation ordering be specified without ambiguity?
Does the dense oracle remain independent?

families.title: Mixed-state multiparameter SLD-QFIM probe design
families.objective: Optimize a noisy probe circuit using the symmetric-logarithmic-derivative quantum Fisher information matrix under explicit rank and conditioning bounds.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use DMCircuit for parameterized noisy channels and backend Jacobians; compute the stable spectral SLD formula as support code.
families.oracle_design: Finite-difference density derivatives and an independent eigenbasis SLD implementation with hidden parameter points.
families.novelty_note: Adds multiparameter information geometry and rank-aware mixed-state optimization, unlike current energy/fidelity objectives.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Combines noisy circuit AD, complex-valued Jacobian conventions, rank-deficient spectral formulas, and a non-scalar design objective.
families.falsification_check: Require a lower eigenvalue bound and agreement between AD and finite-difference QFIMs before any solver trial.
review_questions: Is the state rank safely bounded?
Are SLD and parameter-order conventions explicit?
Is the target reachable without optimizer luck?

families.title: Fault-tolerant flagged CSS state preparation
families.objective: Synthesize a flagged CSS logical-state preparation circuit that preserves the target stabilizers and detects every declared low-weight propagated fault.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Construct and execute the candidate encoder, flag checks, and injected Pauli faults as TensorCircuit circuits; use tableau logic only as an independent verifier.
families.oracle_design: Polynomial stabilizer/isometry checks plus exhaustive single-fault propagation and exact small-code state verification.
families.novelty_note: Directly fills the QEC/fault-tolerant-synthesis roadmap gap; StabilizerBench reports that advanced fault-tolerant synthesis remains largely unsuccessful for frontier agents.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Requires constructive stabilizer reasoning, flag placement, propagation analysis, and exact fault-tolerance semantics; this is supported by direct agent-benchmark evidence rather than size alone.
families.falsification_check: Reject if the held-out CSS family lacks a short expert construction, if any fault class is underspecified, or if the TensorCircuit execution is only a wrapper around a classical tableau answer.
review_questions: Which held-out CSS codes have short expert circuits?
Are all injected fault locations and acceptance rules explicit?
Does exhaustive fault enumeration remain below the verifier budget?

families.title: Non-Markovian memory-channel system identification
families.objective: Identify a recurrent system-memory interaction from intervention sequences and predict held-out multitime observables.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Represent the system plus compact memory as a recurrent TensorCircuit/DMCircuit and differentiate held-out intervention losses.
families.oracle_design: Generate data from a sealed parameter set and score held-out process predictions, with small Choi/process-tensor cross-checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds temporal memory and predictive process identification beyond the Markovian channel calibration in task 04.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Requires recognizing a non-Markovian latent memory model, building recurrent interventions, and avoiding parameter-gauge traps.
families.falsification_check: Require Fisher/identifiability rank and score predictions rather than raw parameters to eliminate gauge ambiguity.
review_questions: Is the hidden model identifiable up to a declared gauge?
Are interventions informationally complete?
Can held-out predictions be verified deterministically?

families.title: Symmetry-resolved Rényi entropy from charged moments
families.objective: Evaluate charged replica moments and reconstruct U(1)-resolved second Rényi entropies for a structured many-body circuit state.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Build two circuit replicas, insert swap and charge operators, and contract sector moments with TensorCircuit's tensor-network engine.
families.oracle_design: Direct reduced density matrices on small instances and an independent MPS calculation on the production scale.
families.novelty_note: Adds replica observables and symmetry-sector reconstruction; task 11 checks string order but not entanglement resolution.
families.reserve_note: Strong reserve after contraction-path profiling; replica width currently raises more feasibility risk than the selected ten.

families.title: Mixed-state negativity witness through replica moments
families.objective: Apply local noise through a purification and evaluate a third partial-transpose moment using opposite cyclic permutations on three replicas.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit channels/purification and a three-replica tensor-network contraction with explicit permutation gates.
families.oracle_design: Direct partial transpose and eigendecomposition on tiny density matrices plus a separately constructed replica contraction.
families.novelty_note: Adds nonlinear mixed-state entanglement witnesses and replica structure absent from the current suite.
families.reserve_note: Strong reserve after a three-replica memory and numerical-margin canary.

families.title: Floquet CPTP steady state and subleading mode
families.objective: Find a noisy Floquet channel's fixed point, subleading eigenvalue, and corresponding decay-mode observable without materializing the full superoperator.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Apply a DMCircuit-defined channel to arbitrary density inputs and wrap it as a matrix-free map for a non-Hermitian eigensolver.
families.oracle_design: Explicit superoperator diagonalization at n=4 and residual/biorthogonality checks at production scale.
families.novelty_note: Adds channel fixed points and mixing spectra rather than state or energy optimization.
families.reserve_note: Strong reserve once a public arbitrary-density-input canary and spectral-separation certificate pass.

families.title: OTOC profile by backward light-cone extraction
families.objective: Compute an out-of-time-order correlator profile for a large local Floquet circuit by folding forward/backward evolution and pruning exact causal cones.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Construct the folded TensorCircuit evolution only on each observable's causal cone and reuse compiled contraction structure.
families.oracle_design: Full-circuit statevector checks on small systems plus an independent Heisenberg-operator/light-cone implementation.
families.novelty_note: Extends task 09 from local forward observables to non-time-ordered forward/backward dynamics and operator spreading.
families.reserve_note: Scientifically strong reserve, but novelty versus challenge 09 must be demonstrated first.

families.title: Quantum signal-processing phase synthesis
families.objective: Recover parity-constrained phase factors for a hidden target polynomial and verify the resulting TensorCircuit QSP response on an independent grid.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Implement the QSP SU(2) sequence as a parameterized TensorCircuit and use backend AD to fit phase factors under fixed gauge conventions.
families.oracle_design: Independent polynomial evaluation, unitarity/parity identities, and dense response checks on hidden grid points.
families.novelty_note: Adds constructive fault-tolerant-era algorithm synthesis instead of NISQ variational physics.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Requires mapping polynomial parity and gauge constraints to a numerically stable phase parameterization, not merely composing familiar gates.
families.falsification_check: Reject targets whose phase solution is unreachable, ill-conditioned, or dominated by an external classical package.
review_questions: Does TensorCircuit remain central rather than a final wrapper?
Is the phase gauge fixed?
Do hidden grid checks prevent polynomial hard-coding?

families.title: Petz recovery for a nonunital correlated channel
families.objective: Construct a transpose-channel recovery from a reference code state and evaluate hidden-state entanglement fidelity after a correlated nonunital channel.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use DMCircuit/Kraus evolution for the channel and recovered states; support code may compute stable matrix square roots and channel adjoints.
families.oracle_design: Independent dense Choi/Kraus construction, trace-preservation checks, and hidden-state entanglement fidelities.
families.novelty_note: Adds information-theoretic channel recovery rather than decoding a sampled Pauli syndrome.
families.reserve_note: High-reasoning reserve; promote only if TensorCircuit remains central rather than a thin wrapper around dense linear algebra.

families.title: Correlated surface-code tensor-network decoder
families.objective: Evaluate logical coset likelihoods for a seeded correlated-noise surface-code syndrome using a bounded-bond tensor network.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit/TensorNetwork contraction infrastructure for the likelihood network and expose convergence in bond dimension.
families.oracle_design: Exact enumeration on small distances and a separately implemented boundary-MPS decoder at production distance.
families.novelty_note: Directly fills the QEC/decoding roadmap gap.

families.title: Logical randomized-benchmarking inference
families.objective: Simulate seeded logical Clifford sequences under a recovery channel and fit logical decay with uncertainty calibration.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit noisy circuits for physical and logical sequence execution with vectorized seeds.
families.oracle_design: Analytic depolarizing cases plus independent maximum-likelihood fit and coverage checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds logical performance characterization and statistical inference.

families.title: Process-tensor decoder for temporally correlated noise
families.objective: Decode a small stabilizer code under spatiotemporally correlated process-tensor noise.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use recurrent TensorCircuit system-environment circuits and contract decoder likelihoods across time.
families.oracle_design: Exact joint system-environment evolution on small rounds and likelihood residual checks.
families.novelty_note: Combines the two absent areas of QEC and non-Markovianity.

families.title: Channel-adapted approximate QEC recovery
families.objective: Optimize a compact recovery circuit for amplitude damping and coherent crosstalk on a fixed code.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use DMCircuit channels and differentiable recovery circuits.
families.oracle_design: Semidefinite or dense channel optimum on tiny codes with hidden-state fidelity tests.
families.novelty_note: Adds code-aware noisy optimization rather than ordinary VQE.

families.title: Noisy magic-state distillation channel
families.objective: Simulate a compact magic-state distillation circuit with correlated noise and report yield, output Bloch vector, and logical infidelity.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit postselection/noisy channels and explicit stabilizer measurements.
families.oracle_design: Exact density-matrix propagation and analytic ideal-protocol identities.
families.novelty_note: Adds fault-tolerant resource-state processing.

families.title: Leakage-aware robust GRAPE control
families.objective: Optimize a qutrit-aware control pulse across detuning and amplitude-error ensembles while penalizing leakage.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit qudit/custom-gate primitives with Diffrax/JAX evolution and automatic differentiation.
families.oracle_design: Independent matrix-exponential propagation and gradient finite differences on hidden ensemble members.
families.novelty_note: Extends task 06 to robust pulse-level control and leakage rather than variational analog blocks.
families.why_plausibly_hard: The solver must reconcile qutrit leakage, differentiable time evolution, control constraints, and worst-case ensemble performance; a pulse that works only at the nominal Hamiltonian is insufficient.
families.falsification_check: Reject if the pinned image lacks a stable differentiable propagator, the expert cannot meet the runtime gate, or random restarts dominate the outcome.
review_questions: Are amplitude, bandwidth, and leakage conventions complete?
Can hidden ensemble members test robustness without optimizer lottery?
Does the independent propagator agree at every gate boundary?

families.title: Noise-spectrum-aware dynamical-decoupling design
families.objective: Choose pulse timings that suppress a seeded colored dephasing spectrum while preserving a target gate.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Simulate noisy pulse sequences with TensorCircuit and differentiate timing parameters.
families.oracle_design: Independent filter-function integral plus direct small-system propagation.
families.novelty_note: Adds spectral noise control and timing synthesis.

families.title: Sparse Lindbladian parameter learning
families.objective: Infer Hamiltonian and jump-operator rates from seeded multitime observables with complete-positivity constraints.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use differentiable DMCircuit or ODE evolution for the parameterized generator.
families.oracle_design: Held-out time predictions and independent Liouvillian exponentiation.
families.novelty_note: Adds generator learning beyond fixed Kraus calibration.

families.title: Collision-model non-Markovianity witness
families.objective: Simulate repeated system-ancilla collisions with memory and compute information-backflow and divisibility witnesses.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Build repeated ancilla circuits with partial resets and reduced-state diagnostics.
families.oracle_design: Independent dense maps and analytic Markovian limit cases.
families.novelty_note: Adds operational non-Markovianity diagnostics.

families.title: Quantum-trajectory feedback stabilization
families.objective: Stabilize a target state using seeded weak-measurement trajectories and branch-dependent feedback.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit trajectory channels, measurements, vmap, and feedback gates.
families.oracle_design: Master-equation ensemble average and fixed-seed trajectory statistics.
families.novelty_note: Deepens task 07 from projective VQE feedback to continuous stabilization.

families.title: Kibble-Zurek ramp and defect scaling
families.objective: Simulate a parameter ramp through an Ising critical point and fit the defect-density scaling exponent across sizes and ramp times.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit Trotter or ODE evolution with vectorized scale instances.
families.oracle_design: Free-fermion solution and small dense propagation.
families.novelty_note: Adds dynamical critical scaling rather than fixed-state optimization.

families.title: Loschmidt echo and dynamical phase transitions
families.objective: Compute return-rate cusps after a many-body quench and identify hidden critical times.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Contract TensorCircuit forward evolution against the initial state across a time grid.
families.oracle_design: Exact free-fermion or diagonalization reference with cusp residuals.
families.novelty_note: Adds nonequilibrium phase diagnostics.

families.title: Noisy Floquet time-crystal response
families.objective: Measure subharmonic response and lifetime under a disordered Floquet circuit with seeded local noise.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use repeated TensorCircuit layers, local observables, and noisy trajectories or DMCircuit at controlled size.
families.oracle_design: Small exact dynamics and independent transfer-matrix extrapolation.
families.novelty_note: Adds long-time disorder-robust dynamics.

families.title: Thermofield purification and thermal correlators
families.objective: Prepare a thermofield double approximation and compute thermal energy and correlation functions across temperatures.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use doubled TensorCircuit states with variational imaginary-time updates.
families.oracle_design: Exact Gibbs observables on small systems and independent MPO purification.
families.novelty_note: Adds finite-temperature physics and purification.

families.title: Real-time Green's function and spectral reconstruction
families.objective: Evaluate a retarded correlator after local insertion and reconstruct stable spectral peaks under a fixed window.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit real-time evolution, overlaps, and vectorized time points.
families.oracle_design: Lehmann representation from exact diagonalization on small systems.
families.novelty_note: Adds frequency-domain reconstruction.

families.title: Berry curvature and many-body Chern number
families.objective: Prepare parameterized ground states on a twist-angle grid and compute a gauge-invariant discrete Chern number.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit variational states and overlap plaquettes across boundary twists.
families.oracle_design: Exact diagonalization and integer-quantization checks away from gap closure.
families.novelty_note: Adds topological response; task 11 only checks one string-order phase.

families.title: PEPS boundary contraction for 2D observables
families.objective: Contract selected local and string observables of a structured 2D circuit/PEPS without a full statevector.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit tensor networks and an explicit bounded boundary-MPS contraction.
families.oracle_design: Exact small lattices and independent quimb boundary contraction.
families.novelty_note: Related to task 08 but focuses deterministic PEPS observables and convergence rather than sampling.

families.title: Quantum Lanczos excited-state spectrum
families.objective: Generate imaginary-time Krylov states and solve a stabilized generalized eigenproblem for low excitations.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit state preparation/overlaps and framework AD for variational imaginary time.
families.oracle_design: Exact eigenspectrum and subspace residual checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds Krylov subspace conditioning and excited states.
families.why_plausibly_hard: A correct solution must build overlap and Hamiltonian matrices from quantum states, diagnose near-linear dependence, regularize without deleting the physical subspace, and report residual-certified excited energies.
families.falsification_check: Plant a known spectral gap and reject instances whose target eigenpairs are not stable across a declared regularization interval.
review_questions: Is the conditioning range difficult but numerically identifiable?
Are basis gauge and truncation rules explicit?
Do residual checks prevent simply returning exact reference energies?

families.title: Degeneracy-aware VQD and transition amplitudes
families.objective: Find a low-energy degenerate manifold and compute symmetry-resolved transition amplitudes without controlled-unitary tests.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit batched state overlaps, Hamiltonian expectations, and constrained optimization.
families.oracle_design: Exact spectrum/projectors and basis-invariant subspace fidelity.
families.novelty_note: Adds excited states, degeneracy, and transitions.

families.title: Active-space UCC circuit with symmetry checks
families.objective: Construct and optimize a seeded active-space UCC ansatz while preserving particle number and spin parity.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit Pauli rotations and sparse Hamiltonian expectations.
families.oracle_design: FCI energy on small active spaces and symmetry/gradient checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds chemistry mapping and symmetries, though the optimization pattern resembles VQE tasks.

families.title: ADAPT-VQE operator-pool selection
families.objective: Grow a symmetry-preserving ansatz by exact gradient ranking and optimize after each selected operator.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit AD/vmap to score an explicit Pauli excitation pool.
families.oracle_design: Independent commutator gradients and exact energy references.
families.novelty_note: Adds discrete adaptive architecture decisions.

families.title: Molecular energy gradient and Hessian response
families.objective: Differentiate a variational molecular energy with respect to circuit and Hamiltonian geometry parameters, including a mixed Hessian block.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit/JAX nested AD with sparse parameterized Hamiltonian terms.
families.oracle_design: High-order finite differences and analytic Hellmann-Feynman limits.
families.novelty_note: Adds response properties and second derivatives.

families.title: Fermionic Green's function with particle/hole sectors
families.objective: Compute particle and hole Green's functions with correct Jordan-Wigner signs and reconstruct spectral weights.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use FGS when applicable and TensorCircuit circuits for a seeded weak interaction impurity.
families.oracle_design: Lehmann representation and exact diagonalization on small systems.
families.novelty_note: Adds fermionic sign conventions and spectroscopy.

families.title: Variance-certified shadows for high-weight Hamiltonians
families.objective: Design a seeded locally biased or derandomized shadow schedule for a fermionic Hamiltonian under a fixed variance budget.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit shadow/sampling infrastructure for state preparation and measurements.
families.oracle_design: Exact expectations plus repeated fixed-seed coverage and analytic variance bounds.
families.novelty_note: Adds measurement resource optimization rather than exact expectation evaluation.

families.title: Importance-sampled direct fidelity estimation
families.objective: Certify a non-stabilizer target using importance-weighted Pauli measurements and calibrated confidence intervals.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit state preparation and batched Pauli sampling.
families.oracle_design: Exact fidelity and repeated confidence-interval coverage.
families.novelty_note: Adds statistical certification.

families.title: Bayesian adaptive phase estimation
families.objective: Estimate an eigenphase by choosing interrogation times and feedback phases from a seeded posterior update loop.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit controlled evolutions, measurements, and branch-dependent feedback.
families.oracle_design: Closed-form likelihoods and posterior calibration across hidden phases.
families.novelty_note: Adds sequential Bayesian control and phase inference.

families.title: Quantum-kernel alignment with PSD constraints
families.objective: Train a feature-map circuit to improve a seeded kernel-target alignment while preserving a numerically PSD Gram matrix.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit batched overlaps, vmap, and AD over feature-map parameters.
families.oracle_design: Independent overlap calculation and PSD/alignment checks on held-out points.
families.novelty_note: Adds quantum machine learning and dataset batching.

families.title: Constraint-preserving NAE3SAT QAOA
families.objective: Optimize a seeded NAE3SAT instance with a feasibility-preserving mixer and verify approximation quality across hidden clauses.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit Pauli-phase layers and exact expectation/sampling.
families.oracle_design: Classical exhaustive optimum at controlled size and exact circuit simulation.
families.novelty_note: Adds combinatorial constraints but risks being a conventional QAOA task.

families.title: QAOA parameter transfer across spin-glass instances
families.objective: Learn one parameter schedule that transfers across a seeded ensemble of weighted spin-glass graphs.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit vmap over graph instances and batched expectations.
families.oracle_design: Exact costs and fixed-seed baselines on every graph.
families.novelty_note: Adds robust generalization across instances.

families.title: Variational quantum linear solver with local cost
families.objective: Prepare the normalized solution of a structured sparse linear system and certify local and global residuals.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit parameterized states and Pauli-decomposed local costs.
families.oracle_design: Classical sparse solve and hidden-vector residual checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds linear algebra but must avoid a classical-solve shortcut.

families.title: Continuous-time quantum-walk hitting profile
families.objective: Simulate a sparse graph quantum walk and identify hitting-time resonances under marked-vertex perturbations.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Encode graph-Hamiltonian evolution in TensorCircuit and measure marked-set probabilities.
families.oracle_design: Sparse matrix exponentiation and graph symmetry checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds graph dynamics rather than variational optimization.

families.title: Resource-constrained quantum architecture search
families.objective: Select gates and parameters under a two-qubit budget to reach a hidden-state fidelity target across instances.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit batched differentiable candidate circuits with a fixed gate library.
families.oracle_design: Known teacher circuits and exact fidelity/resource checks.
families.novelty_note: Adds circuit design and discrete search.

families.title: Variance-aware circuit cutting reconstruction
families.objective: Cut a structured circuit at fixed wires, execute TensorCircuit subcircuits, and reconstruct selected observables with a bounded sampling overhead.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit for every subcircuit and measurement basis; NumPy may perform declared classical recombination.
families.oracle_design: Uncut small circuits and exact quasiprobability reconstruction identities.
families.novelty_note: Adds distributed/cut execution and classical recombination.
families.why_plausibly_hard: The task couples quantum subcircuit construction to signed quasiprobability recombination and variance allocation; local correctness does not guarantee an unbiased global estimate.
families.falsification_check: Require an exact reconstruction identity before enabling finite-shot scoring and reject cuts whose sampling overhead exceeds the resource envelope.
review_questions: Are basis conventions at each cut fully specified?
Is the shot budget statistically powerful?
Can hidden observables expose sign or normalization mistakes?

families.title: Shallow circuit identity and diamond-distance bounds
families.objective: Bound the distance of a hidden shallow local circuit from identity using local witness circuits and compare to an exactly solvable family.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit local witness contractions over light-cone partitions.
families.oracle_design: Exact operator distances for free-fermion or tiny circuits.
families.novelty_note: Adds formal circuit verification rather than state generation.

families.title: Dynamic-circuit branch equivalence certificate
families.objective: Given two measurement-conditioned circuits with resets and feed-forward, construct a branch-sensitive certificate or counterexample showing whether their induced quantum instruments agree.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Execute every declared measurement branch as a TensorCircuit instrument and compare conditional output maps; support code may perform independent Choi linear algebra.
families.oracle_design: Independent branchwise Choi matrices, trace-preservation identities, and planted inequivalent mutations with exact witnesses.
families.novelty_note: Adds semantic verification of adaptive circuits rather than another feedback-control objective.
families.why_plausibly_hard: Ordinary unitary equivalence is insufficient: the solver must preserve measurement probabilities, normalized conditional states, reset semantics, and later feed-forward across all reachable branches.
families.falsification_check: Reject if the pinned TensorCircuit API cannot express every branch directly or if the verifier silently averages away branch-specific errors.
review_questions: Are zero-probability branches handled explicitly?
Can mutations isolate each dynamic semantic failure?
Is TensorCircuit doing substantive instrument execution?

families.title: Multi-stage teleportation with noisy feed-forward
families.objective: Execute chained teleportation/reset stages with calibrated mid-circuit readout errors and mitigation.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit measurement trajectories, classical conditions, reset, and noisy channels.
families.oracle_design: Exact branch enumeration and ideal teleportation identities.
families.novelty_note: Adds communication-style dynamic circuits, though it overlaps task 07 feedback.

families.title: Symmetry-verified zero-noise extrapolation
families.objective: Combine local gate folding, symmetry verification, and stable extrapolation for a seeded noisy many-body observable.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit noisy circuits for every folded scale and symmetry-resolved measurement.
families.oracle_design: Known zero-noise expectation, independent folding checks, and bias/variance decomposition.
families.novelty_note: Adds an end-to-end error-mitigation pipeline.

families.title: Variance-budgeted probabilistic error cancellation
families.objective: Decompose a calibrated local noise inverse into implementable operations and estimate a hidden observable within a fixed overhead budget.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit for calibrated noisy operation samples and batched seeded trajectories.
families.oracle_design: Exact channel inverse at tiny size plus bias/coverage tests over many fixed seeds.
families.novelty_note: Adds quasi-probability mitigation and statistical overhead.

families.title: Correlated readout-error mitigation
families.objective: Calibrate a sparse correlated readout model and mitigate hidden high-weight parity observables without a dense confusion matrix.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Use TensorCircuit sampling and readout-error primitives with structured classical inversion.
families.oracle_design: Known planted confusion model and exact small-system matrix inverse.
families.novelty_note: Adds scalable measurement calibration.

families.title: Memory-constrained contraction plan and selected amplitudes
families.objective: Plan and execute a tensor-network contraction for a structured nonlocal circuit under an explicit peak-memory budget, returning selected amplitudes and contraction-cost evidence.
families.tensorcircuit_path: Build the circuit and execute the accepted contraction plan through TensorCircuit/TensorNetwork; dense statevector materialization is infeasible at the production scale.
families.oracle_design: Exact amplitudes on reduced circuits, independently contracted production amplitudes, and measured peak-memory/cost checks for the submitted plan.
families.novelty_note: Turns scalable simulation into a constructive planning problem with a checkable scientific output, complementing representation-only tasks 08-10.
families.why_plausibly_hard: The solver must translate circuit structure into an executable contraction strategy, respect an operational memory cap, and obtain correct amplitudes without an exponential intermediate.
families.falsification_check: Reject instances whose graph structure makes every contraction exponential under the cap or whose reference plan relies on an unpinned private optimizer.
review_questions: Is the accepted plan feasible on the actual Docker memory limit?
Can peak memory be measured reproducibly?
Do hidden amplitudes prevent hard-coded outputs while remaining independently checkable?
